meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 命令行工具的安装状态,找出过期、走样或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 Codex 安装后行为异常,想确认本地环境是否需要更新或修复
copy.tagline_en: Health-check your Codex CLI install and flag stale, drifted, or broken setups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if Codex acts up after an install or update and you want your local setup audited

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会检查本地 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 安装，把版本、配置、插件载荷和最新源码逐一对比，产出一份 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告，每条结论都附上对应命令输出或文件作证据；诊断期间不改动你的安装、配置或仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查，或提到 LazyCodex 等关键词，或在安装、更新、改配置后 Codex 行为异常、怀疑环境过期或损坏时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一次 LazyCodex doctor 检查
say.note: 会先同步最新源码，再逐项核对本地安装

say.text: 我的 Codex 更新后行为不对，检查一下环境
say.note: 先跑非递归探测，再给 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告

say.text: 检查一下 Astra 就绪状态

howto.what_en: Claude inspects your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install, compares versions, config, and plugin payload with the latest sources, and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report citing command output. It changes nothing in your install or config.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex, or Codex acts oddly after an install, update, or config change, or you suspect a stale or broken setup.

say_en.text: Run a LazyCodex doctor check for me
say_en.note: Syncs latest sources, then audits your local install

say_en.text: Codex behaves oddly after an update—check my setup
say_en.note: Runs non-recursive probes and a PASS/WARN/FAIL report
Compares codex version and gpt-6-astra in models_cache.json
